notes.title: Summer Event, Exclusive Skins & Pickups
notes.content: [p][b]From August 12 to 27[/b], grab your towel, SPF, and bring all your ninja-bros to the beach — it’s time for the first-ever [b]Nekki Summer Fest 2025[/b]. [/p][p][b]Two weeks to collect Starfish and trade them for rewards:[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]3 skins: Beach Ronin and two divers — The Abyss Explorer & Treasure Hunter  [/p][/*][*][p]5 beach battle pickups: Duck Down hammer, Aqua Gun, Bonk inflatable bat, Disarming Cocktail shadow-bomb, and Diving Tank  [/p][/*][*][p]8 summer profile customization sets: frames, backgrounds, and avatars  [/p][/*][*][p]2 sunny emojis[/p][/*][/list][p]Use codes: [b]NSF1[/b] and [b]SFN7[/b] to get your first summer customization set.[/p][p]Play in any mode, earn Starfish (the better you play, the more you get), and grab the limited rewards before the wave takes them away![/p][p][b]On [url="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nekki.ninjaparty"]Google Play[/url] & [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3186180/Ninja_Party/"]Steam[/url]   Coming soon to [url="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ninja-party-online-pvp/id6514312909"]iOS[/url] and Nintendo Switch[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515346/ffe78e5aa97f238821ec880ee9a119771ba2c621.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Ninja Party: What’s Next — New Mode, iOS Release & Bug Fixes | NinJournal #1
notes.content:
[p][i]Welcome to #NinJournal — our new dev log where we share future plans and behind-the-scenes stories.[/i] 
[/p][p]Today, our producer is here to tell you what’s coming in the next updates, ninja-bro![/p][p][/p][p][b]TL;DR for the laziest ninjas:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Bug fixes — we’re aware of the matchmaking and performance issues and are actively working on them.  [/p][/*][*][p]New “Blitz” mode — ultra-fast matches with no boring downtime between rounds.  [/p][/*][*][p]iOS version — polishing the build, launching alongside Blitz mode.  [/p][/*][*][p]Progression — leveling up will be easier, and rewards will come faster. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Read the full post here:[/b][/p][p][url="https://ninjaparty.com/news/ninjournal-1-whats-next-new-mode-ios-release-bug-fixes/"]https://ninjaparty.com/news/ninjournal-1-whats-next-new-mode-ios-release-bug-fixes/[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]And tell us in the comments what you think about Blitz!

notes.content: [p]Ninjas, assemble! Playtests have officially started — and you’ve got 1 week to jump in and show us what you’ve got 💥 [/p][p][/p][p][b]How to jump in:[/b]   [/p][p]💻 Steam — if you pre-registered and clicked Request Access, the game should already be in your library as Ninja Party Playtest.[/p][p]📱 Android — download the file and install it: [url="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Pjth5hIlblfmLFYYpRSgaZyBTJOi3BHB/"]drive.google.com/file/d/1Pjth5hIlblfmLFYYpRSgaZyBTJOi3BHB/[/url] [/p][p]🍏 iOS — open TestFlight and find build 386.
